messages.subject: Sep 22 meeting and presentation
parts:
The first regular monthly meeting of our R user group is scheduled for
next Tuesday, September 22, 2 p.m., at Microbial Sciences Building
(MSB, 1550 Linden Dr.), room 2301. Brian Yandell and Karl Broman
will present a talk on making R packages.

Hope to see you all there.

Yury
